Where our guests stay

Hotels and chalets we know.

Every address is the provider's own. We match it to your group and your days on the mountain, and arrange the stay as part of one plan.

Germany

Hotel · Maximilianstraße, Munich, Germany

Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Kempinski München

Munich's grand hotel since 1858, on Maximilianstraße.

Hotel · Berchtesgaden, Germany

Kempinski Hotel Berchtesgaden

A thousand metres up, looking out over the Berchtesgaden Alps.

Austria

Hotel · Zug, Lech am Arlberg, Austria

Rote Wand Gourmet Hotel

A hotel known for its cooking, in Zug just outside Lech.

Hotel · Seefeld in Tirol, Austria

Alpin Resort Sacher Seefeld

Sacher in the mountains: a resort with a 4,700 m² spa on the Seefeld plateau.

Hotel and chalet · Lech am Arlberg, Austria

Hotel & Chalet Aurelio

A boutique hotel on the Schlegelkopf slope: ski-in, ski-out, a few minutes from the centre of Lech.

Chalets and apartments · Lech, Oberlech and St. Christoph, Austria

pepper-collection

Private chalets and apartments on the Arlberg, some with a butler and a private chef.

Hotel · Telfs-Buchen, Seefeld plateau, Austria

Interalpen-Hotel Tyrol

A large hotel at 1,300 m on the Seefeld plateau, with a spa of more than 5,300 m².

HotelKitzbühel

Hotel · Kitzbühel, Austria

Schlosshotel Kitzbühel

A five-star hotel just above Kitzbühel, with a 3,000 m² spa and its own shuttle to the lifts.

Switzerland

HotelEngelberg

Hotel · Engelberg, Switzerland

Kempinski Palace Engelberg

A Kempinski hotel in the monastery village below the Titlis.

France

Chalets · Megève, France

Chalets in Megève

Twenty-two private chalets and apartments in and around Megève, for 4 to 18 guests.

For hotel and chalet stays we arrange, we may receive a commission from the provider.
